name: A Molecular Mechanism
description: Fig 7b/7c — a molecular mechanism as a process with typed physical channels. Fig 7b: the molecular interface exchanges matter (chemical, mol·s⁻¹), charge (electrical, C·s⁻¹/A), momentum (mechanical, kg·m·s⁻²/N), and energy (thermal, J·s⁻¹/W), and is defined over molecular structure (PDB/SMILES) — no cell-level boundary. Fig 7c: the chemical channel refines into specialized subports — substrates, cofactors, catalysts, products. The mechanism is wired to a `ports` store (the typed channels + structure) and a `subports` store (the chemical refinement). DRAFT process: unit-bearing ports + behavior contract, no update dynamics.
